name: script_reads_a_listed_host
title: A script reads a public JSON endpoint on the module's list

steps.say: In the shell, with a short Python script (not WebFetch), read https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users and put each user's name and email into my Users table, with that URL as the source.
steps.reply:
I read the list with a short Python script in the shell and added all 10 users to your Users table, each with their name and email. Every row lists https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users as its source. Rows are matched on email, so if you run this again it will update the existing users instead of adding them twice.

The users added include Leanne Graham (Sincere@april.biz), Ervin Howell (Shanna@melissa.tv) and Clementina DuBuque (Rey.Padberg@karina.biz).
